item.title: Man loses family, home in deadly Denham Springs fire
item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS &mdash; A Denham Springs man lost his family and his home when it caught fire on Saturday morning.&nbsp; &nbsp;The fire occurred around 6:20 a.m. on Wanda Avenue, taking the lives of James Garrett, 96, his great-granddaughter, 22-year-old Kirsten Vidrine, and her best friend, 20-year-old Danielle Ricard.&nbsp;43-year-old David Vidrine escaped the fire but sustained injuries. item.title: Pedestrian hit by vehicle along Greenwell Springs Road on Monday night
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A person walking along Greenwell Springs Road was hit by a car and taken to a hospital Monday night.&nbsp;Emergency officials said the crash happened along Greenwell Springs, just off of Lone Oak Drive, around 6:45 p.m.&nbsp;The person was taken to a hospital in critical condition.&nbsp;The Baton Rouge Police Department is investigating the crash.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; A Baton Rouge woman celebrated her 110th birthday on Monday.&nbsp;Mildred Bowie grew up in New Orleans but moved to Baton Rouge in her adulthood.
